definitions.explanation: winning by a very large margin; a decisive, one-sided victory

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧5-0⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{圧勝|あっしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The team won an overwhelming victory, 5-0.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{圧勝|あっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: They achieved a landslide victory in the election.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{圧勝|あっしょう}だった。
examples.english: It was an overwhelming victory, as expected.

notes:
{圧勝|あっしょう} describes a decisive victory with a large margin.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {圧|あつ}: Pressure, overwhelming
- {勝|しょう}: Victory

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {圧勝|あっしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to win overwhelmingly)
- {圧勝|あっしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}める→収める：02022_osameru⟧ (to achieve an overwhelming victory)
- ⟦{大差|たいさ}→大差：08410_taisa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{圧勝|あっしょう} (overwhelming win by a large margin)

USAGE:
- Sports: Winning games by large margins
- Elections: Landslide victories
- Competitions: Dominant performances

DEGREES OF VICTORY (from easiest to closest):
- {圧勝|あっしょう} (overwhelming victory)
- ⟦{快勝|かいしょう}→快勝：08237_kaishou⟧ (easy victory)
- ⟦{辛勝|しんしょう}→辛勝：08238_shinshou⟧ (narrow victory)

ANTONYM PAIRS:
- {圧勝|あっしょう} ↔ ⟦{惨敗|ざんぱい}→惨敗：08236_zanpai⟧ (crushing defeat)
- ⟦{快勝|かいしょう}→快勝：08237_kaishou⟧ ↔ ⟦{大敗|たいはい}→大敗：08201_taihai⟧ (heavy defeat)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in sports and political news.
